description: Golden eval set for the Trupti Dance Academy RAG bot. 'scored' items get RAGAS metrics; 'routing_only' items check router/language behavior (multilingual + escalation answers would confuse an English LLM judge).

scored.question: What time is the Teen Dance class?
scored.reference: The Teen Dance class (ages 12-18) is on Fridays from 5:00 PM to 6:00 PM.

scored.question: How much do dance classes cost?
What should my daughter wear to class?
scored.reference: Wear comfortable, breathable clothing that allows free movement, such as leggings, t-shirts, or tank tops. Avoid jeans or restrictive clothing. Students dance barefoot or in dance socks, so no special shoes are required.

scored.question: Does my child need any prior dance experience to join?
scored.reference: No prior experience is needed. Classes are designed for all experience levels and instructors break down moves step by step so complete beginners can follow along.

scored.question: Can I get a refund?
scored.reference: 4-class session enrollments are non-refundable. If the academy cancels a class, it is not counted and an automatic class credit is applied with the enrollment end date extended. Special circumstances are reviewed case by case.

scored.question: What happens if the academy cancels a class?
scored.reference: An academy-canceled class is not counted; an automatic class credit is applied and the enrollment end date is extended accordingly.

scored.question: Can I try a class before committing to a full session?
scored.reference: Yes, the academy occasionally offers trial classes or drop-in sessions; contact the academy to learn about current opportunities. A trial class counts as the first class upon enrollment and only one trial class is permitted per student.

scored.question: What is BollyX and who can join it?
scored.reference: BollyX is a Bollywood-inspired dance fitness program combining dynamic choreography with music from around the world - a high-energy cardio workout. It is for ages 16 and up, all fitness levels, on Mondays and Wednesdays 6:30-7:30 PM, and no dance experience is necessary.

scored.question: When is the recital?
scored.reference: The academy held its first Annual Recital on Friday, May 30, 2026, from 6:00 to 8:00 PM, and that event is already complete. No new recital date has been announced yet, though the academy plans to make it an annual tradition.

scored.question: Can I get a refund for the recital fees if my child withdraws?
scored.reference: The recital has its own refund policy: the participation fee is refundable minus a $15 administrative fee if the performer withdraws in writing at least 30 days before the recital; withdrawals fewer than 30 days before are not eligible. The costume fee is non-refundable once costumes are ordered. Audience tickets are non-refundable but transferable.

scored.question: My niece dances at another studio - can she perform in the recital?
scored.reference: Yes. External and community performers who are not enrolled at the academy are welcome to perform in the recital and register through the same form at the external fee tier.

scored.question: What age groups performed in the recital?
scored.reference: The recital had five categories: Kids 4-6, Kids 7-8, a Girls group 9-15, a Ladies group 15+, and a Parent and Child category for toddlers aged 2-3 dancing with a parent.
